finding.text: Deliverable 1 ("definitely want to get the same UX on the dictate page... across the entire site") is still not done — `ux/Dictate` has no `ChatPanel` usage anywhere (grep found none), and the task log itself says the Dictate sheet variant "waits, ux/Dictate is still fenced." This diff only wires select/rename/marks into the drawer and the demo page, not onto Dictate itself. Worth a line in the landing report so it doesn't read as finished.

"Drill in" (asks item 3 — tap a card to expand, sheet goes full-screen with its own routed paging) isn't in this diff at all; task.jsonl shows it was split to a queued `next-drill-in/` task. That's a reasonable split, but requirements.md's own list still shows it unchecked, so the review should say it's deferred, not silently missing.

The owner's $15 hard budget looks exceeded: task.jsonl logs minion-hitl-widgets alone at $7.70, plus three more paid minions (hitl-api, chat-wire "well under $4", chat-finish capped $2.50) and three Opus review passes (~$0.66 each) on top. Nothing in the task log adds these up or reports a final total against the $15 stop the owner asked for — worth a one-line total in the landing report even if it's over.

`ChatPanel.js`'s `watch_session(this.watch, …)` (line ~400) starts a polling interval via `ext/Session`'s `watch()` but nothing ever calls `this.stop_watch()` — no destroy/unmount hook exists in this framework's `View`, so once a caller actually passes `watch`, a torn-down panel keeps polling forever. Low risk today since no caller wires `watch` yet, but worth a note before the voice-sessions follow-up starts using it.

`Chat.js`'s new `document.addEventListener("keydown", …)` for Esc-to-deselect (around line 203) is added once per `chat()` call with no matching removal. The demo page instantiates several `ChatPanel`s at once, so each stacks its own listener; harmless today (each checks its own closed-over `$selected`) but it's an unbounded accumulation if panels are ever created and discarded repeatedly on one page.

The fix for the ✓→loop-back and the inline-mark placement (resolve_mark, append_mark, the wrapped `view.write`) was applied correctly and matches `ux/Understand`'s and `ux/Content/Decision`'s own shapes — `on_chosen` reads `line.chose.option`, which is what `Decision`'s `write()` actually sends. No issue found in the wiring itself.

No simpler route was obvious: select/rename/marks genuinely need to live inside `chat()` for DOM access, and the diff already reuses `ux/Rename`'s `rename_options()` and `ux/Understand`'s `marks()` rather than rebuilding them, per its own `doc/decisions.md`. The scope here looks appropriately minimal for what shipped.

Deliverable 1 ("one widget everywhere") is only half true: `public/framework/ext/Chat/ChatPanel.js` is wired into the drawer (`public/framework/ext/drawer/rail.js:615,648`, `public/framework/ext/drawer/tabs/ai.js:255,277`) and the demo page, but `public/framework/ux/Dictate/` has zero `ChatPanel` references (confirmed by grep) — the "real mobile sheet embedded live as a Dictate variant" the requirements call out as missing is still missing after this diff.

Deliverable 3 ("drill in": tap a card to expand, full-screen sheet with routed paging) is not in this diff at all — no full-screen shell, no paging, no expand-on-tap-with-contents logic anywhere in `Chat.js`/`ChatPanel.js`. `task.jsonl` shows it was split to a queued `next-drill-in/` task, which is a reasonable call, but the requirements.md checklist item isn't marked deferred anywhere visible to a reader of this diff alone.

The owner's "$15 HARD" budget (requirements.md line 40) looks blown: `task.jsonl` shows minion-hitl-widgets alone at $7.70, plus hitl-api, chat-wire, chat-finish ($2.50 cap) and three Opus review passes (~$0.66 each) on top — nothing in the landing sums this against the stated $15 stop, only a later note claiming "$20 against a $20 cap" that doesn't match the brief's own $15 line.

`ChatPanel.js`'s `watch_session(this.watch, ...)` (around line 400 of the new code) starts `ext/Session`'s `watch()`, a self-rescheduling `setTimeout` poll, and stores `this.stop_watch` — but nothing in `ChatPanel.js` ever calls it, and this framework's `View` has no destroy/unmount hook to call it from. Harmless today since no caller passes `watch` yet, but it's a live leak waiting for the first caller that does.

`Chat.js`'s new `document.addEventListener("keydown", ...)` for Esc-to-deselect (around line 203) is added once per `chat()` call with no removal. `panel/page.js`'s demo mounts several `ChatPanel`s on one page, so listeners stack; each closes over its own `$selected` so it's harmless today, but it accumulates if panels are ever created/discarded repeatedly.

The core wiring (select → rename dropdown → `fix: true` line; mark badge placement via `append_mark`; clarification-card loop-back via the wrapped `view.write` → `on_chosen` → `resolve_mark`) is internally consistent and matches `ux/Rename`'s and `ux/Understand`'s own shapes — reuse over rebuild, as `doc/decisions.md` claims. No correctness bug found in this path.

No simpler approach stands out: select/rename/marks genuinely need DOM access inside `chat()`, and the diff reuses `rename_options()` and `marks()` rather than re-implementing them. Scope for what actually shipped (select, rename, marks, one clarification-card demo) looks appropriately minimal.
